title: Internal Penetration Tester
description:
About the Role
The Internal Penetration Tester works to execute offensive security activities for Pathfynder by A-LIGN . In this role, you will be responsible for the delivery of internal network and cloud-based SaaS penetration testing engagements. As the Internal Penetration Tester, you will provide exceptional technical and client-focused testing strategies to help support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the Internal Penetration Tester to independently identify and validate real-world security risks, manually exploit vulnerabilities, document findings, and communicate practical remediation guidance to clients.
Reports to
Director, Internal Offensive Operations
Pay Classification
Full-Time, Exempt
Responsibilities

• Execute internal network and cloud-based SaaS penetration testing engagements

• Identify, validate, and manually exploit vulnerabilities using public exploits, custom-developed exploits, or a combination of techniques

• Evaluate findings in context, explore realistic attack paths, and accurately assess business and technical risk

• Deliver clear, accurate, client-ready reports that explain findings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance

• Communicate technical issues, testing results, and remediation recommendations to client stakeholders

• Maintain project quality and timelines while executing assigned engagements with minimal oversight

• Collaborate with the offensive security team to evaluate industry tools, improve delivery methods, and share technical knowledge

• Mentor team members and contribute to the continued development of team capabilities

Minimum Qualifications
EDUCATION

• Degree in cybersecurity, computer information systems, related discipline or equivalent professional
EXPERIENCE

• 5+ years of hands-on offensive security experience, including at least 3 years focused on internal network, Active Directory, red team, or purple team penetration testing

• Experience with network and system exploitation across enterprise environments

• Knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and current offensive security practices

• Experience applying current tactics, techniques, and procedures related to EDR bypass, lateral movement, and privilege escalation

• Preferredred team or purple team penetration testing experience

• Preferred wireless penetration testing experience

• Preferred consulting or client-facing security delivery experience

CERTIFICATIONS

• Preferred OSCP, CEH, or OSEP certification.

• Preferred additional advanced certifications relevant to internal network, Active Directory, red team, or cloud security testing

SKILLS

• Passion for information security and identifying exploitable vulnerabilities before threat actors can take advantage of them.

• Ability to discover and exploit complex vulnerabilities while maintaining a disciplined and repeatable approach to testing.

• Knowledge of Active Directory attack paths, network exploitation, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and defence evasion techniques.

• Proficiency with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or SQL.

• Proficiency with commonly used offensive security tools such as Nmap, BloodHound, the Impacket suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, and Nessus.

• Knowledge of multiple penetration testing concentrations and the ability to select appropriate methodologies and tools.

• Ability to write clear, concise, client-ready reports with accurate findings and actionable remediation guidance.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, remote environment while meeting deadlines.

• Continuous desire to grow technical capabilities, improve delivery efficiency, and share knowledge with team members and clients.

• Cloud architecture knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Goo

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About the Role:

Rho’s data has two types of consumers: people and AI agents. As our data analyst, you will empower both with reliable data and meaningful insights. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role that involves everything from data pipelining to delivering recommendations. You will model new data for Rho’s latest features and product lines. You will build the semantic layer that defines how Rho measures itself and turn analyses into decisions with stakeholders across the whole business.

The increased adoption of agentic tools and the acceleration of Rho’s own product velocity result in more people consuming data, more data-backed outputs, and even more business questions to answer. More than ever, it’s imperative that a data team ensures reliable self-service data for routine reporting or inbound requests while being hands-on for deeper analysis that drives decision-making.

You’re accountable for faster and data-driven decision-making, not for the number of dashboards or reports built. This is a cross-functional role that will interface with data engineering as well as business-side stakeholders from GTM, Product, and other departments. This role is based in our New York office and reports to our Manager, Product Analytics who is also based there.

What You’ll Do

- Drive business decision-making by working directly with stakeholders across the company to scope ambiguous questions, conduct analyses, and transform analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Proactively uncover opportunity areas as a holder of domain knowledge across verticals. Operate flexibly across verticals and function as a subject matter expert on data sources and key metrics.

- Empower Rho’s internal data consumers. Enhance data enablement through building and maintaining models via dbt. Own the end-to-end process: onboard raw warehouse data, add relevant tests and documentation, curate end-user tables, and debug any subsequent breakages.

- Ensure that data is accurate and useful for end-users, analysts, and AI agents by collaborating with data engineering and sharing relevant business context.

- Uphold data integrity and governance standards by maintaining consistent metric definitions within the dbt semantic layer.

- Own BI reporting for multiple verticals, ranging from Compliance to GTM. Build or tune any required reporting, and safely deprecate obsolete assets.

What You Bring

- 2 to 4 years of experience as a data analyst, business analyst, analytics engineer, business intelligence engineer, or similar role

- A growth mindset and ability to quickly learn about new business domains or product surface areas in a fast-moving environment

- Outstanding SQL ability, and particularly comfortable with debugging complex logic

- Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders

- Hands-on experience building models in dbt or similar data transformation frameworks

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt to audiences of varying technical backgrounds

- You already use AI to move faster, whether it’s by automating repetitive tasks or drafting initial analyses. You are curious about what’s next.

- Prior experience in building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Omni, Hex, Tableau, and other business intelligence or analytical tools

Nice to Have

- Experience working in financial services, banking, technology or a fast-paced startup

- Experience supporting multiple verticals or departments simultaneously

- Experience building out a dbt semantic layer and refining the warehouse as a surface area for both humans and AI agents

- Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive analytics

title: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) - Somerville, MA
description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? - Act as a security educator, cultivating a culture of shared responsibility across the AI, chemistry, and engineering teams.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You are motivated by the mission of using AI for planetary-scale impact and understand the high stakes of securing "deep tech" intellectual property.

- 3+ years of experience in a DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Site Reliability Engineering role, preferably within a fast-paced startup or AI-centric company.

- Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).

Trusted Access helps eligible customers access and use advanced AI capabilities with appropriate safeguards. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence.

We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own the Trusted Access operating strategy and lead a team of risk-operations specialists. You will set priorities across programs, build a reliable customer access service, and hire, manage, and develop your direct reports.

This role combines program ownership with formal people management. You will establish shared commitments with technical support and regional escalation leaders, who manage their own teams, and bring those groups together around customer outcomes. You’ll stay close enough to complex cases to challenge assumptions while giving specialists the ownership and capacity to fix recurring problems.

Success means customers reach the right access outcome with clear communication, teams make consistent decisions, and the service scales with less avoidable escalation and manual work.

In this role, you will:

- Own the operating strategy and roadmap across Trusted Access programs, translating customer needs and organizational priorities into clear service commitments, ownership, and investment decisions.

- Build a coherent customer journey from application and eligibility review through approval, provisioning coordination, and confirmed access, including appeals and subsequent access changes. Establish clear handoffs and route exceptions to authorized decision-makers.

- Hire, coach, and develop your team. Set expectations, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, address performance gaps, and build the capabilities needed as programs grow.

- Make capacity and prioritization decisions across urgent customer needs, launch readiness, and lasting improvements. Coordinate regional coverage, vendor support, and backup with partner teams while protecting time to eliminate recurring work.

- Lead consequential customer escalations, bringing incomplete or conflicting evidence into a clear decision process. Align owners on the next action and ensure customers receive accurate updates and a clear resolution.

- Turn support patterns into a prioritized roadmap with Product and Engineering: improve onboarding, provisioning workflows, tooling, self-service, and AI-assisted operations. Validate that changes work before expanding them.

- Establish measures of service health and decision quality. Distinguish fast responses from actual resolution, investigate persistent delays, and use evidence to change priorities.

- Prepare new programs and customer channels for launch and scale. Align support responsibilities, review standards, customer guidance, and technical dependencies; make readiness gaps and tradeoffs clear to leadership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have built and run complex customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or service operations, with measurable improvements beyond handling more volume.

- Have formally managed people through hiring, development, difficult feedback, and performance decisions, and can show how your leadership increased the team’s capability and ownership. 5+ years of management experience preferred.

- Can make defensible tradeoffs among customer commitments, safeguards, service quality, and capacity, even when stakeholders disagree or the evidence is incomplete.

title: Senior Data Scientist- Travel Tech
description:
About the Role

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers travel for some of the world's largest brands through our APIs, white label products and fintech, and every dataset we hold tells a story our partners need told clearly, repeatedly and fast. As a Senior Data Scientist on HTS you will own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of partners and build the machinery that answers their questions about supply health, pricing competitiveness and performance once, then answers them every week. You will be judged less on the sophistication of your models than on whether the people you work with, inside Hopper and across partner commercial teams, make better decisions because of you.

What would your day-to-day look like

- Own the analytical relationship with a portfolio of HTS partners, working alongside Partner Success and Commercial to understand what they need, deliver it, and present it directly to their teams

- Design and templatize repeatable reporting on supply health, pricing competitiveness and tenant performance that scales across hotels, flights, homes and cars without being rebuilt each time

- Use AI assistants, agents and code generation tools as everyday collaborators to automate the repetitive parts of analysis and reporting, and help the broader team adopt the same practices

- Frame and run exploratory analyses that deepen our understanding of partner and traveler behavior, and translate what you find into clear recommendations for product, engineering and business leaders

- Apply machine learning and statistical methods to large, messy datasets where they move the needle, and recognize when a simple, well explained metric is the better answer

- Build dashboards and self serve reporting in BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude and Google Sheets, with an eye toward making yourself unnecessary for routine questions

- Partner closely with product and engineering so the data we collect supports the questions our partners will ask next

An ideal candidate has

- A degree in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience

- Extremely strong analytical and problem solving skills, with a track record of answering hard questions with data across more than one domain or product line

- A proven ability to turn complex technical work into simple, credible narratives for non technical and executive audiences, including external partners

- Comfort being partner facing, presenting findings, fielding tough questions live and building trust with commercial counterparts

- Deep SQL skills and experience with modern data warehouses such as BigQuery, plus fluency in Python and Pandas or R for large scale data preparation and analysis

- Hands on, daily use of LLM based tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot for writing code, SQL, analysis and documentation, and a point of view on where they help and where they fall short

- Experience building or deploying automated and agentic workflows, from scheduled pipelines to LLM driven report generation and prompt or skill libraries, that turn one off analyses into repeatable products

- Experience with data mining, machine learning and statistical modeling, and the judgment to know when to reach for them

- Experience with business reporting and experimentation tools such as Tableau, Looker or Amplitude

- A strong bias toward simplifying, templatizing and shipping over polishing

- Travel industry experience in lodging, air, vacation rentals or car rental, or in a marketplace, B2B platform or API distribution business, is a plus

- Experience with geographic data in search, filtering or recommendation, or working with external customers in a consulting, solutions or customer analytics capacity, is a plus

Perks and benefits of working with us

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

- Unlimited PTO

- Carrot C

title: Sr. Software Engineer - IT Software Engineering
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Could we build a better version of an expensive SaaS tool on Elasticsearch? Our new IT Software Engineering team asks that question about the software Elastic pays for, and then we build the answer. Each system helps run the company day to day and becomes a reference architecture for Elastic's own products.

We're a team of builders, and this is a hands-on, 100% individual contributor role. Every engineer here owns their work end to end: shaping the problem, designing the system, shipping it, and keeping it healthy for years. Knowing what to build, and what not to build, matters more here than typing speed.

What this role is not: 

• Not a front-end role. The user interface follows a shared kit and is the simplest part of the work.

• Not a prototype or demo role. What we ship runs in production and is maintained for years.

• Not vibe coding. We use AI to build faster, not to skip design, review or testing.

• Not SaaS administration or configuration , and not an infrastructure-only or DevOps-only role.

• Not a people-management role.

What You Will Be Doing

• Take an open business problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and turn it into a clear spec, data model and API contracts.

• Build internal applications that replace paid, specialized tools.

• Solve the hard parts that all of these applications share:

• reading data from several systems of record accurately and efficiently, without overloading or slowing those systems down

• storing sensitive data so it never leaks

• enforcing permissions on the server, so each person sees only the records and fields they are allowed to see

• Design and evolve the shared, versioned building blocks that every application is built from: data connectors, authorization, data storage and migrations, search, and reporting.

• Build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code inside a disciplined, spec-driven process. Acceptance criteria are traced to tests, interface contracts get compatibility checks, and small slices are reviewed and proven before the next one starts. Automated quality gates decide when work is done.

• Own what you build for its whole life: review, testing, releases, production operations including on-call, new features, maintenance and, eventually, retirement.

• Help set the team's standards for architecture, contracts, testing and observability, and feed what you learn back into Elastic's products.

What You Bring 

• Senior-level experience designing, shipping and maintaining production backend systems through failures and changing requirements, not just launching them.

• Sound judgment about what to build, what to leave out, and how to keep a system simple as its requirements change. You apply abstraction, separation of concerns, single responsibility, SOLID and common design patterns where they fit.

• Strong API and data design: clear contracts and careful data models, and the ability to change both without breaking the people who depend on them.

• Experience integrating with other systems (APIs, databases, event streams) safely and efficiently.

• Security-first thinking about authorization and sensitive data.

• Search fundamentals. You can explain:

• how information is indexed and how text is processed

• how results are scored and ranked

• when to use keyword, vector (semantic) or hybrid se

We do it by placing next-generation sensing equipment aboard commercial ships and turning the global fleet itself into a living network that illuminates the maritime domain in ways legacy AIS never could. Better maritime domain awareness means safer mariners, more secure sea lanes, and an ocean that can no longer go dark. Every vessel we bring onto the network extends that picture a little further.

The network only exists if ships join it. This role owns that mission end-to-end: enlisting the right vessels across priority ship types and regions. You will find target fleets, win over owners, close agreements, and shepherd the relationships that keep them contributing to the network long term.

This role sits at the foundation of how we scale. Rather than stepping into a rigid playbook, you will actively participate in designing and refining our acquisition workflow from day one. - Synchronize supply acquisition with Quartermaster’s broader growth targets and regional maritime coverage demands so deployment teams are never bottlenecked by vessel availability.

- Determine headcount needs by ship type, geography, and stage of acquisition; hire, mentor, and level up acquisition specialists and field leads as the company expands.

- Cultivate deep subject matter expertise across key maritime segments (e.g., container, bulk, tankers, specialized craft) within the team to eliminate coverage blind spots.

- Operationalize the Funnel: Instrument acquisition metrics, tracking pipeline health, stage velocity, conversion rates, and acquisition costs.

OUTCOMES YOU'LL OWN

- Operational Repeatability: Establish a documented, hardened acquisition playbook that new team members can run out of the box.

QUALIFICATIONS

title: Data Center Architect
description:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

- Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

- Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

- Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

- Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

- Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

- Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

- Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

- Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

- Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

- Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

- Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

- Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

- Track the roadmap

Some of our biggest accounts are Chinese platforms, 3PLs and brokers moving millions of parcels into the UK. They grow with us when parcels arrive on time, issues get fixed fast, and someone on our side always knows exactly what’s going on. That someone is you.

As our Mandarin-speaking Senior Operations Account Manager, you’ll take on some of the most complex of these accounts and set the standard for how we run account operations as we scale. - Fix things once. Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes with our operations, quality and finance teams, then share them across every pod.

About the company: 

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs-by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. title: Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator
description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator is a hands-on technology role responsible for the day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of computing infrastructure inside Lila Sciences' laboratory environments. This role owns the layer of technology that sits between corporate IT and operational technology (OT), the workstations, edge compute, lab-area networking, and instrument-adjacent systems that enable autonomous science to run reliably.

Reporting to the Senior Director, OT Security and IT/OT Convergence, the Lab IT/OT Systems Administrator works in close partnership with the OT network architecture team, corporate IT operations, facilities/building automation, and laboratory operations leadership. The successful candidate is comfortable operating in a complex, fast-moving research environment where standard corporate IT practices do not always apply, where change control matters more than speed, and where the end users are scientists running irreplaceable experiments on highly specialized equipment.

This role is a key part of Lila's IT/OT convergence program. In addition to delivering day-to-day operational support, the person hired will contribute to the standards, device catalog, and playbooks that scale the function as the company grows, working under the direction of the Senior Director, OT Security and IT/OT Convergence.

What You'll Be Building

Lab IT Operations and Support

• Provide day-to-day administration and troubleshooting for laboratory computing assets, including lab-area workstations, edge compute nodes, lab-supplied PCs, and dedicated lab-network infrastructure (switches, access points, cabling).

• Respond to and resolve Lab IT incidents and service requests through the enterprise ITSM platform, applying appropriate prioritization for experiments in progress and time-sensitive scientific work.

• Maintain a strong on-site presence across Lila's laboratory locations; observe how scientists and lab operators use technology in practice and proactively identify issues before they become tickets.

• Coordinate scheduled maintenance windows for Lab IT systems in alignment with laboratory operations leadership; ensure changes do not disrupt active experiments.

Instrument-Adjacent and OT Boundary Support

• Provide IT-side support for laboratory instruments and automated platforms, including networking, identity integration, agent deployment decisions, and image/configuration alignment with company standards.

• Partner with the OT network architecture team, instrument vendors, and laboratory automation engineers to support new instrument deployments and changes, recognizing that instrument-connected systems require specialized handling distinct from standard corporate endpoints.

• Troubleshoot authentication, networking, and connectivity issues on vendor-supplied lab equipment, including systems with non-standard configurations, embedded operating systems, or unique vendor account models.

Asset Management and Inventory

• Maintain accurate, current Lab IT asset records in the enterprise CMDB, including device tier, owner, location, configuration baseline, and lifecycle state.

• Apply company labeling standards (QR/barcode asset tags linked to CMDB records) to Lab IT assets and conduct periodic ownership reconciliation.

• Serve as a primary point of contact when security or vulnerability management tools generate alerts on Lab IT assets, executing the workflow of alert review, asset identification, owner notification, and resolution.

Standards, Onboarding, and Procurement Support

• Contribute to the development and ongoing maintenance of the standardized device catalog and golden image program for laboratory computing equipment.

• Support the secure onboarding of new laboratory instruments and platforms, including baseline configuration, segmentation placement, monitoring enrollment, and owner assignment.

description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!
About National Taxpayers Union Foundation
National Taxpayers Union Foundation is a non-partisan research and education organization dedicated to showing Americans how taxes, government spending, and regulations affect them. Through data collection, analysis, and commentary, we empower citizens to engage in the critical policy debates of our time and hold elected officials accountable. To educate our target audiences, we perform incisive research and analysis on a wide range of policy issues with a particular focus on tax, technology, interstate commerce, legislative scoring, and trade. We also have a newly launched public interest litigation project that has extended our work into the judicial sphere.
About the Role
Assist with NTUF research, analysis, and outreach efforts focused on budget and tax reform. Responsibilities include tracking and analyzing policy proposals and budget data, and contributing to issue briefs and other content for NTUF's website.
This role is open to remote or onsite candidates.
**Qualified candidates must submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and NTUF’s mission and may include this in the "Additional Information" field seen after clicking the "Apply for this Job" button.**
Candidates may also be asked to engage with NTUF's other projects, including:

• Taxpayers’ Budget Office: Support efforts to improve fiscal transparency, strengthen cost estimates, eliminate budget gimmicks, reduce wasteful spending, and expose costly government perks.

• Free Trade Initiative: Support initiatives that educate Americans about the economic benefits of trade.

• Center for State Competitiveness: Collaborate on efforts to resist the growing trend of states seeking to tax and regulate outside their borders, disrupting interstate commerce.

Ideal candidates will possess:

• Basic quantitative skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• An interest in public policy issues, specifically budget, tax, and regulatory matters.

• Strong research, communication, and writing skills.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

Intermediate Data Scientist - Healthcare AI & Data Harmonization
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Intermediate Data Scientist to support the development and implementation of enterprise-scale data harmonization and automation solutions within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain.
This individual will design, develop, and optimize intelligent data processing pipelines that ingest, transform, normalize, and map large volumes of heterogeneous medical data, including structured clinical, genomic, and operational datasets, as well as unstructured information such as clinical notes and pathology reports.
The role will leverage advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), semantic search, and automated data mapping techniques to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of medical data harmonization.
The successful candidate will have hands-on experience with Python, machine learning frameworks, big data processing technologies, and healthcare data standards. Exposure to specialized AI computing infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs, will be particularly valuable.

• Develop reusable mapping frameworks to support data standardization, interoperability, and integration across multiple data repositories.

• Identify opportunities to improve mapping accuracy, reduce manual intervention, and increase processing efficiency through AI-driven automation.

AI, Machine Learning & Accelerator Optimization

• Improve the performance of embedding generation, tokenization, model inference, and semantic matching processes.

• Evaluate model accuracy, processing performance, and computational efficiency across different datasets and use cases.

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

• Build and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines capable of handling large, potentially terabyte-scale healthcare datasets.

• Develop distributed data processing workflows using PySpark and other big data technologies.

• Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into standardized data processing environments.

• Implement efficient data transformation, validation, and orchestration processes.

• Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

NLP & Unstructured Medical Data Extraction

• Develop and implement NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) models to extract relevant clinical information from unstructured medical documents.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant, Procure to Pay

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

Zip is the leading procurement orchestration platform, helping companies like Block, OpenAI, Anthropic, CIBC, DollarTree, T-Mobile, and AMD manage how they buy. As a Senior Solutions Consultant on our Procure-to-Pay team, you’ll lead the implementation of Procure-to-Pay customers from kickoff to go-live, configuring Zip around their real procurement approval workflows, and shaping our product roadmap around your customer insights.

YOU WILL

- Lead end-to-end implementations across Zip’s Procure-to-Pay product, owning delivery from kickoff through go-live

- Lead discovery and design workshops with process owners and AP teams to understand their processes and pain points, and translate them into scalable, best-practice workflows

- Serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through configuration decisions, explaining trade-offs, and constructively challenging requests that add unnecessary complexity

- Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, driving alignment across customer stakeholders and keeping scope, decisions, timelines, and dependencies on track

- Proactively identify and resolve project risks, navigate difficult conversations, and escalate issues when needed to keep implementations moving forward.

- Partner with Technical Solutions Consultants and other internal teams to coordinate integrations and deliver a cohesive customer experience

- Lead testing and go-live readiness, helping customers validate workflows, resolve issues, and confirm the solution meets their business requirements.

- Deliver training and enablement so customers can confidently own and manage Zip after go-live

- Partner with Product and Engineering to communicate customer needs, evaluate requests, and set clear expectations with customers

- Share customer feedback, support peers, and contribute to implementation playbooks to shorten time to value and elevate the customer experience

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years as an AP or finance systems implementer, or customer-facing implementation lead in B2B SaaS

- Working knowledge of AP processes (invoice coding, three-way match, tax treatment, multi-entity and multi-currency setups) and the confidence to advise controllers and AP teams

- Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent projects and balancing competing priorities using project management methodologies

- Hands-on experience implementing or integrating with an ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle Fusion, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage Intacct, etc.), including how POs, bills, and payments flow through it, is a plus

- Comfort with configuration-heavy software work and using AI tools to speed up your own work; SQL or API skills are a plus

- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering

- The judgment to push back on client requests and guide them toward best practice while keeping the relationship strong

PERKS & BENEFITS

- 🌴 Flexible PTO

description:
Bist du bereit, dich mit uns auf eine spannende Reise zu begeben? Wir leben own (y)our growth und fördern ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung Hand in Hand gehen.

Stell dir vor, du betreust Kunden, die ein Produkt nutzen, das die Art und Weise, wie Parkplätze verwaltet werden, revolutioniert. Damit hast du einen bedeutsamen Einfluss auf die Zukunft der urbanen Mobilität.

- Optimierung: Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung unseres Kundenservices und leitest Feedback an die jeweilige Abteilung weiter

Inspire us by

- Dein Background: Du hast zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Kundensupport, Call Center oder Kundenbetreuung und dies mit dem Fokus auf (eskalierendem) Beschwerdemanagement

- Deine Mentalität: Du verfügst über ein dickes Fell und ausgeprägte Standfestigkeit: Du kannst Kunden auf Augenhöhe klare Grenzen aufzeigen und unpopuläre Entscheidungen verbindlich vertreten, ohne dich provozieren zu lassen

- Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest gerne analytisch und suchst nach kreativen Lösungen für die Probleme deiner Kunden

- Work Ethic: Du möchtest in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung arbeiten, Eigeninitiative zeigen und bist hoch motiviert neue Fähigkeiten zu erlernen

- Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast Deutschkenntnisse auf C2 Niveau und verfügst über grundlegende Englischkenntnisse, weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

What we offer

- Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

- Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

- Teamkultur & Networking: Echte Verbindungen - auch abseits vom Daily Business. Feiere Erfolge mit uns bei legendären Teamevents und Spirit Days

- Produktive Umgebung: Dein Wohlbefinden ist die Basis für starke Performance. Damit du auch aus der Ferne topfit und gesättigt bleibst, unterstützen wir dich mit einem monatlichen Essenszuschuss

- Gesundheit & Ausgleich: Bleib in Balance mit EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club - deutschlandweit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen

- Top-Equipment & Ergonomie: Ob Mac oder Windows, im Office oder remote - Deine Effizienz und dein Arbeitskomfort kommen nicht zu kurz

- Dresscode? Dein Code: Bei uns zählt, was du bewegst - nicht, was du trägst. Zieh an, worin du dich am wohlsten fühlst

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Still here?
Dann könnten wir ein perfektes Match sein!

Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen.
Falls du Fragen hast, schreibe gerne an Julian Höge unter Julian.Hoege@wemolo.com.

Ready to own (y)our growth?

description: Rohlik wurde 2014 in der Tschechischen Republik gegründet und ist der europäische Marktführer im Bereich E-Grocery in Mitteleuropa. Das Unternehmen ist bereits in der Tschechischen Republik ( Rohlik.cz ), Ungarn ( Kifli.hu ), Österreich ( Gurkerl.at ), Deutschland ( Knuspr.de ) und weiteren Märkten aktiv. Durch die vollständige Kontrolle über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette, einschließlich der hauseigen entwickelten Technologie, bietet Rohlik ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis sowie die frischesten Lebensmittel von lokalen Landwirten und Manufakturen neben einer breiten Auswahl an Supermarktprodukten. Abteilung Das Facility & Engineering Team sorgt für einen sicheren, zuverlässigen und effizienten täglichen Betrieb unserer Fulfillment Center, indem es Infrastruktur, Anlagen und technische Systeme instand hält. Durch vorbeugende und korrektive Instandhaltung minimieren wir betriebliche Risiken und ermöglichen eine kontinuierlich hohe Leistungsfähigkeit. Deine Rolle Als Techniker:in bist du für die Instandhaltung und Zuverlässigkeit der technischen Anlagen und der Infrastruktur unseres Lagers verantwortlich. Du führst vorbeugende Wartungsarbeiten durch, behebst Störungen und stellst die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsstandards sicher. Indem du die Verfügbarkeit und Funktionsfähigkeit unserer Anlagen gewährleistest, leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum reibungslosen Ablauf unserer Fulfillment-Center-Prozesse.
